description: Create or update a reusable hashtag set (up to 100 per brand, up to 30 hashtags per set) with automatic # normalization, deduplication and platform count advisories for LinkedIn and X.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

hashtags.description: One to 30 hashtags (with or without a leading #); duplicates are removed automatically. Required when creating.

id.description: An existing hashtag set id from hashtag_sets_list to update. Leave out to create a new set.

name.description: A short name for this hashtag set (1 to 60 characters), such as "Local Coffee" or "Product Launch". Required when creating.

networks.description: Optional network keys this set is meant for, such as ["instagram", "tiktok"]. Leave empty for any network.

note.description: An optional note describing when to use this hashtag set (up to 200 characters). Pass null or empty string to clear.

name: hashtag_sets_save
title: Save a hashtag set
